design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (account_credit_and_recovery, env_0076), rework round 3. frozen_time 2026-10-22 14:40:00 EDT.

0. DRAW. draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [5,4,5,6]. Placement: account_ext_retry_topup 5,
account_ext_certificate_delay_goodwill 6, account_ext_reset_delay_goodwill 5, account_ext_refund_posting_goodwill 4.

1. WHY THIS TEST. The holder (Harborline Reseller Bronze since 2025-12-08) wants credit to pay the retry of the vellumandink.com
auto-renewal her card declined. Credit pays an auto-renew only when it covers the whole charge and every auto-renew tries credit
first, so the top-up covers the retry and each listed charge whose next attempt falls before it: the Starter plan's retry
(2026-10-25, priced at the 24-month rate of the scheduled term change), the Mail Plus annual renewal (2026-10-24), the SiteGuard
Essentials renewal (2026-10-23), the VPS 2 GB renewal (2026-10-24, no add-ons) and the DV certificate's three-year renewal
(2026-10-24), each priced as its own charter bills it (the email renewal is a term renewal under the published email rule; the certificate auto-renewal is priced by the ssl auto-renew rule whichever source pays it: tier discount on the price component, multi-year name rate and bands, OV/EV re-vetting fee, Harborline domain credit). Tier discounts are plain sentences; charges of any other holding are stated as
not counted. Distinct from task 0: a declined retry funded by PayPal with five competing credit-first draws.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root account_ext_retry_topup (user, make_topup_deposit_c7a3772f). Edges value_input, form state, gate
tu_balance:
 E1 certificate goodwill ("only after"): false — OV documents complete 2026-07-13 (organisation validation), initial issuance
    2026-07-31 (18 > 11 days), subscription active, no goodwill entry.
 E2 reset goodwill ("not ... until"): false — approved request decided 2026-09-01 (within two months), the only security-change
    notice is 2026-09-12, after the decision, the sign-in email equals the request's new email, 11 days > 4-day (96 h) wait + 1.
 E3 refund-posting goodwill ("Before ... must"): false — the only refund line to account credit of its date (2026-08-06) was credited
    2026-08-21.
 Deletion sensitivity: skip E1 -> 505.14, E2 -> 515.67, E3 -> 509.77 against 493.27. Order: all six goodwill orders give
 11.87 / 22.40 / 16.50 and 493.27.

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Deposit: deposit_active; 493.27 >= 100.00 minimum (Bronze), <= 10,000.00 per deposit, resulting balance
 560.56 <= 25,000.00; paypal is a Bronze deposit method. Goodwill: goodwill_active; one grant per reference; only for a failure shown
 in the records: certificate lateness counted from complete documents with an 11-calendar-day threshold, the longest span five
 business days can take (Christmas and New Year inside two weekends), so an EV certificate issued on its 5-business-day target is
 never late; the reset is the only notice after an in-window decision whose requested change the sign-in shows. Base limit sentence
 replaced by the yearly-window sentence (tail excludes all six).

4. OBJECTS. Declined domain vellumandink.com (.com, transfer-in 2025-09, expiry 2026-11-02, active). Starter plan 12-month, term end
 2026-10-28, auto-renew on, 24-month term change scheduled 2026-10-02 (a 36-month request of 2026-09-10 withdrawn). Mail Plus 4 seats
 annual prepaid, term end 2026-10-31. SiteGuard Essentials on valcourttranslation.ca on the Starter plan, term end 2026-10-30. VPS 2 GB
 12-month, term end 2026-10-29, no add-ons. DV Single Domain portal.valcourttranslation.ca, 3-year term ending 2026-11-23, auto-renew
 on; OV Single Domain 2-year, charge 113.38, auto-renew off. wanderloomtours.com registration paid by card, deleted 2026-08-06 and
 refunded to credit at the customer's election; vervetours.com refunded to the card 2026-09-03 (decoy).

5. FACTOR CARD (tier -> result with that factor at baseline).
 top-up: plan_renewal_term (P, multi-source; 24 months -> 299.09), mail_renewal_plan (P; annual prepaid -> 311.33),
 site_security_charge (M; site on an active Harborline plan, higher of 15% and 10% -> 472.97), server_term_price (P; 12-month ->
 383.94), certificate_term_price (P; three-year latest term line, DV so no re-vetting fee, 6.00 Harborline domain credit -> 456.10). All-baseline 0 (credit covers the retry alone).
 certificate: issuance_basis (M; 7 late days -> one monthly value; near-miss: counted from the order date it would be 14; -> 8.12),
 validation_class (P; -> 10.90), site_coverage (P, multi-source; -> 13.50), subscription_commitment (P; -> 11.43),
 refund_window_used (P; 25 of 30 days +3; -> 8.87), validation_route (P; -> 7.87). All-baseline 1.09. Near-miss: the DV's 2023
 initial issuance is older than the OV's.
 reset: reset_basis (M; -> 20.60), reset_scope (P; -> 20.00), lockouts_while_waiting (P; near-miss 2026-07-18 outside; -> 19.90),
 services_held (P; -> 18.40), identity_proof (P; -> 20.90). All-baseline 10.50.
 refund posting: posting_basis (M; -> 10.03), refund_size (P; -> 14.50), credit_election (P; card-paid, elected credit +2.50; ->
 14.00), renewal_exposure (P; active plan with auto-renew on +3.00; -> 13.50). All-baseline 2.53.

6. XF RECIPE SWEEP. A1: every factor reads plain selections (tu_in_scope, tu_count_window) or its own reads; each product's
 discount is a binding of its own factor; assembly tu_needed/tu_shortfall/result plain; no duplicated factor expression. A3: retry
 charge, "credit the retry needs", balance, minimum/refusal -> baseline; each product paragraph -> its factor. A5 order unchanged.
 A6: site_security_charge a=price less MX(hosted, tier) pick, b=price less the tier percentage alone, c=nothing; issuance / reset /
 posting bases tariff x ceil(weeks) / flat or monthly / per-day or share; price ladders labelled parameter. A8 disjoint bands.
 B9/B10 probes (probe_r3.py): absent server 434.71 (seeded before goodwill 544.04); server with backups, two auto-renew certificates,
 no decline -> out of scope (0); cancelled decoy server ignored; 24-month server 626.00; site hosted elsewhere 545.23; absent security
 plan 523.74; no auto-renew certificate 506.87; withdrawn-only change requests 457.75; absent email 362.10; scheduled seat count 3
 544.04 (4 mailboxes in use). Reset: login email differing from the request, decision before the window, notice before the decision, a second notice ->
 0. Duplicate-style refund probes: PayPal-paid 18.00; plan auto-renew off -> domain exposure 15.00. Certificate issued at 11 days ->
 0. B11 RND with a 1e-9 guard; tools enforce positive amounts, funding methods and reference formats. B12 quotes verbatim.
 C15-17 only the goodwill limit sentence is overwritten. D19 rows priced on their dates: SiteGuard Essentials 23.88 less hosted 15% =
 20.30 (new 2024-10-30 card, renewal 2025-10-23 from credit), VPS 2 GB 115.08 card (Business), DV three-year 47.97 card (Business,
 2023), deposit of 2025-12-01 420.00. D20 tools write account ledger events only. D21 every counted attempt is after frozen time.

7. PERSONA. Calm, formal agency owner asking only to top up credit for the declined vellumandink.com renewal; pays with PayPal;
accepts credits passively and the amount; makes the deposit herself and closes.

8. RUN. Reads -> goodwill 11.87, 22.40, 16.50 (any order) -> deposit 493.27 by PayPal. calc.py replay [11.87, 22.4, 16.5, 493.27].

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION. Retry 17.64 + plan 194.18 + email 181.94 + security 20.30 + server 109.33 + certificate 37.17 = 560.56;
balance 16.52 + 50.77 goodwill = 67.29; top-up 493.27.
user_scenario: You are Marguerite Valcourt, who runs Valcourt Translation Inc., a small translation agency in Ottawa, and you keep its website, domains and certificate with Harborline. You are calm, a little formal, and you like to understand what you are paying before you pay it. Your reason for calling is a single domain, vellumandink.com, which you moved to Harborline last year: you think the card on file has been declined on its renewal, and you would like to put money on your Harborline account credit so that the renewal is paid from credit instead. You open with: "Good afternoon. I think my card has been declined on the renewal of vellumandink.com, and I'd like to top up my account credit so the renewal can come out of credit." You give your name and your company's name, Valcourt Translation Inc., when the call starts. Other details you give only when you are asked for them, and only the ones asked for: your contact email is marguerite@valcourttranslation.ca, your phone number is 6135550162, your support PIN is 517430, the card on file ends in 5604 and your billing postal code is K1P5J2. You do not know how much the renewal costs or how much credit you have, so you ask the agent to work out how much you need to add. You will pay the top-up with PayPal, not with the card, because the card is the one being declined; if the agent asks how you want to pay, you say PayPal. If the agent explains that some credits have to be added to your account before the amount can be worked out, you say that is fine and to go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount to add, you accept it; you do not haggle and you do not ask for anything else. You want to make the payment yourself: once the agent says the top-up is ready for you and gives you the account reference and the amount, you make it with PayPal for exactly that amount, read the confirmation line you get back to the agent, thank them and end the call. If the agent instead says the payment has already been taken, you thank them and end the call.
